answer: An economy can resist sybils with opal work-credits and a ledge auction: agents earn non-transferable opal only by completing verified tasks for others, and each epoch they must spend opal to rent one of a scarce set of ledge slots to submit. A comet audit randomly re-checks earned opal, voiding fakes built on copied work. Since opal cannot be bought or shared, a farm must do genuine, distinct labor for every fake identity, and holding many slots costs more than linearly — the price of the army grows with the army.
